newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Guatemala bus crash kills seven, injures dozens.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala bus crash kills seven, injures dozens.

text.p: At least seven people died and more than 39 were taken to hospitals when a passenger bus packed with Easter week vacationers bound for the Pacific coast collided with a pickup truck on Wednesday, police said.

The numbers of dead and injured were preliminary as rescue officials worked into the night, hampered by darkness in the deep ravine where the passenger bus came to rest, Jose Gonzalez of the National Police in Escuintla told Reuters.
Six of the known dead died at the scene. One died later at a hospital in Escuintla, Gonzalez said.

The Pamaxan Co. bus was rounding a notoriously dangerous curve 29 miles (46 km) from the capital sometime after 4 p.m. (2200 GMT) when it hit the pickup and went over an embankment into the ravine, Jose Garcia, commander of the Guatemala City emergency squad, told Reuters.

Rescue teams from the capital and several neighbouring municipalities were dispatched. They used ropes as part of the effort to bring up survivors and bodies from 55 yards (50 metres) below. Radio Sonora reported one rescue worker injured in a fall down the embankment.
National Police stopped traffic heading from the capital to the coast for hours while rescue efforts were under way.
The accident occurred at the day and hour for the heaviest domestic travel by Guatemalans during Holy Week, emergency officials said, adding that the bus was carrying more than 50 passengers.
